items.markingKey: The displacement current through a circle of radius r is i_d r²/R² (2); Ampere-Maxwell: B·2πr = μ₀i r²/R² (2) ⇒ B = μ₀ir/(2πR²) = 8.00 × 10⁻⁸ T (1).
